hero.title:
Spanish wine,
both ways
hero.sub: Since 2011 I have helped Spanish wineries reach markets around the world, and people living on the Costa Blanca discover what is actually in the bottle.

doors.title: Two ways to work with me
doors.aside: Two very different activities, with the same knowledge of Spanish wine behind both.

items.title: Export & international development
items.desc: I act as an external export manager for wineries with no department of their own, and represent international companies looking to reach the Spanish market.

items.title: Tastings & wine travel on the Costa Blanca

anna.title:
Who is
behind it
anna.p1: Anna Granqvist is Swedish and has lived in Spain for more than twenty years. She has worked professionally in wine since 2011.
anna.p2: She is an educator for the international WSET (Wine & Spirit Education Trust) courses, holds the WSET Diploma, and is a certified educator for the wines of Jerez, Montilla-Moriles, the Canary Islands, Cava and Alicante.
anna.quote: I know the producers, their vineyards and their wines. That is what I take to an international market, and what I talk about in a tasting.
anna.p3: Her track record includes commercial representation of the Meininger Verlag publishing group in Spain, the launch of an online Spanish wine sales project in 2012, setting up a WSET course provider, and exporting wines from Spanish wineries worldwide.

intro.title: How we work
intro.p1: With an extensive international network of freelance wine business professionals, we offer high quality services that adapt precisely to the needs of each client.
bullets: If you are a winery and need to outsource commercial activities, we can help you.
If you are an international company that needs to reach the Spanish market and its producers, we can represent you.

services.aside: Available individually or as an ongoing engagement.

items.title: Sales representation
items.desc: Sales representation for international clients within the wine business.

items.title: International business development
items.desc: Opening and consolidating markets, analysis and market entry strategy.

items.title: Outsourced sales activities

items.title: International direct marketing

items.title: Translation services

manager.title:
External export
manager
manager.p1: We act as the export department for wineries that do not have one of their own.
manager.p2: We build their distribution network in international markets by creating synergies between wineries from different denominations of origin: never putting them in competition with each other, but building a balanced representation of different regions and wine styles.
manager.reach: We export worldwide, with a particularly strong presence in Europe.

clients.title:
Who we
work with
clients.aside: Producers with the capacity to export, but not to keep an export manager on exclusive contract.
clients.p: Family-run, small-production wineries: old vineyards, careful winemaking and high quality. We work with denominations that differ greatly from one another, so each winery adds to the portfolio rather than competing within it.

cta.title: Shall we talk about your winery?
cta.sub: Tell me which markets interest you and I will tell you frankly whether I can help.

hero.title:
Wine tastings & wine travel
on the Costa Blanca
hero.sub: Tastings, pairings, workshops at home, winery visits and wine trips across Spain. With a WSET Diploma educator who knows the producers personally.

offer.title:
Tastings and
courses
offer.aside: At various locations across the Costa Blanca, for open or private groups.

items.title: Tastings and food pairings
items.desc: For groups of wine lovers, for the sheer pleasure of trying Spanish wines from across the country or from one particular region. Also available as training: from an introduction to tasting through to winemaking theory and a tour of the world's benchmark grapes and wines.

items.title: Bespoke tastings and corporate events
items.desc: Experiences designed around each group. They work beautifully as team building: an enjoyable way to learn a little about wine and pairing, with tapas matched to each wine.

items.title: Sommelier workshops at home
items.desc: For small groups who want to open bottles and discover the story behind each producer, and for larger groups looking for a different way to unwind or to get a group talking.

items.title: WSET Level 1 course
items.desc: Official training with a certificate from WSET London: a one-day course with a short exam at the end. Designed for consumers, no prior knowledge needed.

trips.title:
Visits and
wine trips
trips.aside: Fully organised: transport, content, tasting and lunch.

items.title: Winery visit and tasting
items.desc: We visit a winery with access to producers outside the usual wine tourism circuit, the ones everybody does not already go to. Travel, tasting and lunch included, talking wine along the way. It can be combined with a visit to a characterful village, a viewpoint or a short walk.

items.title: Wine travel in Spain and Portugal
items.desc: Trips from the Costa Blanca to different wine regions. Small groups, wineries with something special that do not normally receive visitors, and the food of each region. Always with stops at villages, nature or points of cultural interest, and with Anna alongside you throughout.

privacy.title:
Privacy
policy
privacy.intro: In accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), we inform you of the following regarding the processing of your personal data.

purpose.title: Purpose and legal basis
purpose.p: We process the data you provide through the contact form or by email for the sole purpose of responding to your enquiry and, where applicable, providing the services requested. The legal basis is your consent and the performance of the pre-contractual or contractual relationship.

retention.title: Retention
retention.p: We keep your data for as long as necessary to handle your request and thereafter for the periods required by law. We do not share your data with third parties except where legally obliged to do so.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.p: You may exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction of processing and portability by writing to our email address. You may also lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (aepd.es) if you believe the processing does not comply with the applicable rules.

minors.title: Minors
minors.p: Our services are intended for persons of legal drinking age. Should any of our services be specifically aimed at minors, SALP Consulting will seek the consent of parents or guardians for the collection of personal data or, where applicable, for the automated processing of that data, as set out in current legislation.

moderation.title: Responsible consumption
moderation.p: We support the responsible consumption of wine. All of our activity is aimed exclusively at adults of legal drinking age.
